newsitem.title: JAPAN: NCB June debenture to be set at 2.75 pct - bankers.
newsitem.headline: NCB June debenture to be set at 2.75 pct - bankers.

text.p: Nippon Credit Bank Ltd is likely to cut the coupon rate for its June five-year bank debentures to 2.75 percent from 2.95 percent for its May debentures, sources at long-term credit banks said on Tuesday.
The bank is also expected to cut its June long-term prime rate to 2.9 percent from 3.1 percent in May.
NCB plans to announce the coupon rate for its new five-year debenture and its June long-term prime rate at 4 p.m. (0700 GMT) on Tuesday.

The Industrial Bank of Japan (IBJ) Ltd, the largest of Japan's three long-term credit banks, announced on Monday that it would cut its long-term prime rate for June to 2.9 percent from 3.1 percent in the previous month.
IBJ also said it would cut the coupon rate of its June five-year bank debentures to two percent from May's 2.2 percent.
